messages:
sara_sales: RFP from payments customer: wants BYO-HSM POC with offline key ceremony, split KEK (2 custodians), quarterly rotation, and SOX audit mapping. Can we run a 3-week POC?
luke_se: Yes. Offline ceremony supported. Need their encrypted key blobs + public certs before kickoff. We'll schedule a dry-run day.
priya_sec: Security constraints: no plaintext export, dual-custodian import, require FIPS attestation and vendor CA attestation PDFs. Also they want CSV mapping of KMS API->audit events.
emma_ops: Ops: split-KEK handled by envelope wrap + shard import. Quarterly rotate OK; recommend staggered promotion + rewrap-on-read to avoid downtime. Client reconnect may be needed for long-lived sessions.
sara_sales: Pricing ask: 3-week POC, 4 HSMs, 2 on-call SRE days for ceremony. Ballpark?
luke_se: Quote = standard POC setup + HSM attach daily rate + engineer support daily. I'll draft numbers and SOW lines.
priya_sec: Deliverables: attestation PDFs, audit mapping CSV, runbook snippet for ceremony, token cache guidance.
emma_ops: Runbook snippet:
```
redwood-ops key-ceremony start --mode offline --participants "custodianA,custodianB" --shards 2 --out /secure/pack.enc
```
ops-bot: Created POC ticket POC-5012 :white_check_mark:
sara_sales: I'll ask custodian contacts and confirm required attestations, then post update. Thanks all :thumbsup:
